# 3 Maccabees Chapter 6 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Greek MS (Codex Alexandrinus) | **Section:** Divine Deliverance of the Jews

---

**6:1** In the same way, God who watches over all things, the Father of all mercy, delivered the people of Israel from the peril they were facing.

**6:2** Eleazar did not cease his prayer until God answered him.

**6:3** When the elephants that had been let loose against the Jews were about to advance toward them and trample them underfoot,

**6:4** Ptolemy looked up and saw two glorious angels of fearsome appearance descending from heaven, who were visible to all but the Jews.

**6:5** And they were filled with fear and trembling, for they stood in the midst of the advancing herd, and they turned the elephants back on the troops of Ptolemy.

**6:6** So the furious beasts, trampling and crushing, destroyed many of the soldiers and turned back on the army of the enemy.

**6:7** Then Ptolemy, seeing what was happening, was terror-stricken and began to tremble.

**6:8** He repented of his wicked plot and turned back from the evil he had intended.

**6:9** In the meantime, the Jews were overjoyed and full of confidence because God had heard their prayer.

**6:10** They praised their holy God and their Savior, and began to celebrate and sing hymns of praise.

**6:11** They glorified the mercy of God and praised him who had appeared to them in this way.

**6:12** And the king was now ready to hear the voices of praise of those whom he had sought to destroy.

**6:13** Having called together his Friends and his council, he said to them: You have seen how much the Jews trust in their God and how he has delivered them even from certain death.

**6:14** Tell me, therefore, whether any among you does not acknowledge that God is watching over these people.

**6:15** When the king had said these things, those with him who were wiser among his Friends fell at his feet and acknowledged the power of the God of Israel, whose might had been shown to them.

**6:16** Then the king called for Shimon the high priest, and for the Jewish leaders, to come before him.

**6:17** And he said to them: Do not be afraid, but be of good cheer; for I have heard the prayer that you offered to your God and I have repented of my wickedness.

**6:18** I have been persuaded by the mercy of God to free you all.

**6:19** You shall go back to your homes, and no one shall trouble you or mistreat you.

**6:20** And you shall all receive letters from me, confirming this, addressed to the various communities, that you may return in safety to your own places.

**6:21** He then issued letters which were sent to all the governors and officials throughout Egypt, commanding them to free the Jews and to treat them with respect.

**6:22** And so the Jews were set free from all their sufferings.

**6:23** They returned with gladness to their homes, singing hymns of thanksgiving to the God of Israel who had delivered them.

**6:24** And all who had helped them during their ordeal rejoiced with them.

**6:25** The king returned to his palace with great rejoicing and gave thanks to God.
